title: Employee Funds — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
The employee's fund account — for example a savings or provident fund — over a period.

Payroll deducts the fund contribution according to the fund bands on the employee's grade, and creates this record itself if the employee has none. The account's totals are kept up to date from its fund details.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: Comments
fields.html: What it is. Free-text notes about this record.
